@hakon\_hogetveit1  @alchemist\_studio 300 PRs in a night reads as a red flag to me, not a strength. No team can meaningfully review that volume...

I'm also unsure about the managed cloud. Most teams will run closed models from OpenAI or Anthropic, and both now have their own managed agent offerings in public beta (Agents API and Claude Managed Agents), with no platform fee on top of tokens. I see the case for self-hosting, EU data residency (though OpenAI has EU residency and Anthropic the same via GCP) and being model-agnostic
